title: AD/Windows attack surface (authorized internal)
description: Safe enumeration path for Active Directory environments on Kali.
detail: Authorized internal only. 1) Identify DCs/services (DNS SRV, LDAP 389/636, Kerberos 88, SMB 445). 2) Enumerate with netexec/ldapsearch/smbclient/bloodhound-python where creds/context allow. 3) Look for ASREProast/Kerberoast candidates, SMB signing/relay conditions, shares, delegations - validate carefully. 4) Correlate with ad-attack/ad-pki-certificate skills; record cred/service/vuln facts. Avoid disruptive changes; coordinate with owner.
commands: netexec smb <dc-or-range> --shares -u '' -p ''  # null/guest check if in scope
